sovereign_raw:
{
  "kit": {
    "id": "ss-unique-keeper-of-the-last-harbor",
    "game_id": "sovereign-system",
    "name": "Sovereign of the Last Harbor",
    "rarity": "UNIQUE",
    "class_identity": {
      "role": "Expedition summoner, battlefield commander, and mobile domain sovereign",
      "primary_attribute": "CHA",
      "combat_identity": "A supernatural harbor sovereign who commands vessels and crews formed from condensed twilight water. The sovereign fights directly while directing an independent major general and a limited force of useful subordinates. Combat emphasizes relocating allies, controlling approaches, and coordinating attacks.",
      "sovereign_identity": "The sovereign owns an anchored harbor domain, appoints a major general, and deploys crews from its reserves. The domain provides a functioning headquarters, personnel recovery, and expedition logistics.",
      "playstyle": "Approximately 75 percent personal adventure and expedition combat, with 25 percent domain development, strategic objectives, and occasional defense. The sovereign makes meaningful command decisions while the general handles routine upkeep.",
      "resource_model": {
        "personal_resource": "MP",
        "level_1_capacity": 65,
        "recovery": "Restore MP through the campaign's standard rest rules.",
        "attack_stat": "CHA",
        "ability_save_dc": "13 + CHA modifier",
        "command_range": "30 meters unless an ability specifies otherwise"
      },
      "creation_contract": {
        "grant_timing": "All eight personal abilities and all three sovereign parent abilities are granted automatically when this Class is selected within the existing four creation stages.",
        "additional_board": false,
        "additional_approval": false,
        "immediately_usable": true,
        "sovereign_parent_count": 3,
        "sovereign_parent_rarity": "UNIQUE",
        "ownership": "The sovereign owns personal and sovereign Class abilities. The general and subordinate units own their separately defined entity abilities and use their own turns.",
        "starting_scope": "Personal abilities operate through the character. Sovereign abilities operate through domain infrastructure, force reserves, or command authority."
      },
      "foundation": {
        "name": "The Last Harbor",
        "type": "Class-specific pocket-domain anchored to a physical shoreline",
        "domain": {
          "structures": [
            "Stone quay",
            "Command hall",
            "Repair dock",
            "Storehouse",
            "Six mooring berths"
          ],
          "anchor_gate": "A permanent gate connects the pocket-domain to its chosen physical shoreline.",
          "initial_state": "All starting structures are functional, the anchor-gate is intact, and the domain has 8 Harbor Stores.",
          "access": "The sovereign and authorized companions enter or leave through the gate in 1 minute.",
          "domain_limits": "The harbor has no independent external artillery or automatic attacks."
        },
        "level_1_capacity": {
          "major_general_capacity": 1,
          "starting_major_generals": 1,
          "subordinate_unit_capacity": 4,
          "starting_subordinate_units": 4,
          "mariners_per_unit": 3,
          "maximum_deployed_subordinate_units": 2,
          "initial_deployed_subordinate_units": 2,
          "initial_reserve_subordinate_units": 2,
          "total_initial_personnel": 13,
          "mooring_berths": 6
        },
        "general": {
          "id": "ss-lh-general-01",
          "name": "Breakwater Admiral",
          "owner": "general",
          "type": "Independent major general",
          "independence": "The admiral has its own initiative, combat turn, judgment, personality, and tactical decisions. The admiral follows legitimate strategic orders and acts independently when instructions leave discretion.",
          "stats": {
            "HP": 70,
            "DEF": 15,
            "movement_meters": 6,
            "attack_bonus": 6,
            "attack_damage": "2d8+4 physical",
            "attack_reach_meters": 2
          },
          "abilities": [
            {
              "id": "ss-lh-general-breakwater-order",
              "name": "Breakwater Order",
              "owner": "general",
              "activation": "General Action",
              "group": "Entity Ability",
              "full_rules": "On the general's turn, choose up to two allied subordinate units within 12 meters of the general. Each chosen unit immediately moves up to 3 meters and gains +2 DEF until the beginning of the general's next turn. This replaces the general's ordinary attack. Costs no MP. Cooldown: 3 rounds.",
              "flavor_text": "The admiral's signal sends the harbor ranks into a disciplined defensive formation."
            }
          ],
          "routine_responsibilities": "The general directs harbor security, repairs, store distribution, reserve assignments, casualty reports, and approved construction without requiring individual player orders."
        },
        "subordinates": {
          "id": "ss-lh-mariners",
          "name": "Twilight Mariners",
          "owner": "subordinate_unit",
          "unit_composition": "Three mariners per unit",
          "stats_per_unit": {
            "HP": 24,
            "DEF": 12,
            "movement_meters": 6,
            "attack_bonus": 4,
            "attack_damage": "1d8+3 physical",
            "attack_reach_meters": 2,
            "carrying_capacity_outside_combat_kg": 120,
            "carrying_capacity_during_combat_kg": 60
          },
          "unit_rules": "Each unit occupies one position, has one collective HP pool, and takes one turn per round on its own initiative. Units can attack, guard, transport equipment, operate vessels, or perform comparable mundane tasks. A unit at zero HP is destroyed.",
          "abilities": [
            {
              "id": "ss-lh-mariners-line-haul",
              "name": "Line Haul",
              "owner": "subordinate_unit",
              "activation": "Subordinate Unit Action",
              "group": "Entity Ability",
              "full_rules": "On its turn, a mariner unit throws a supernatural line at a willing creature or unsecured object weighing up to 120 kilograms within 6 meters, pulling it up to 4 meters toward the unit. Against an unwilling creature, roll the unit's +4 attack against its DEF. On a hit, pull the creature 2 meters. This consumes the unit's Action instead of its attack. Costs no MP.",
              "flavor_text": "Three spectral sailors cast a glowing hawser and haul in unison."
            }
          ]
        },
        "replenishment": {
          "resource": "Harbor Stores",
          "starting_stores": 8,
          "store_capacity": 12,
          "passive_generation": "Generate 2 Harbor Stores after each completed 24-hour period while the anchor-gate is intact and at least one subordinate unit is assigned to upkeep.",
          "destroyed_unit_replacement": "2 Harbor Stores and 8 uninterrupted hours at the repair dock per unit.",
          "damaged_unit_recovery": "1 Harbor Store and 4 hours at the repair dock per surviving unit, restoring its full HP.",
          "general_recovery": "The general restores 20 HP after 8 hours resting in the command hall. A defeated general reforms at full HP after 24 hours and payment of 6 Harbor Stores.",
          "repair_capacity": "The repair dock processes one subordinate unit at a time.",
          "normal_upkeep_cost": "Zero Harbor Stores.",
          "risk": "Attacks against the harbor can damage structures, stores, units, or the anchor-gate. Destruction of the anchor-gate interrupts production until repaired."
        },
        "strategic_scope": "Major expansions, expeditions, alliances, warfare, and high-risk commitments require player decisions. Routine operations belong to the general.",
        "quest_structure": "Quests have concrete objectives and finite resolutions. Success, failure, retreat, and abandonment change resources, enemies, relationships, and earned rewards."
      },
      "abilities": [
        {
          "id": "ss-lh-active-01",
          "name": "Broadside of the Drowned Fleet",
          "scope": "personal",
          "rarity": "UNIQUE",
          "activation": "Action",
          "group": "Active",
          "full_rules": "Spend 9 MP and choose a visible point within 20 meters. A supernatural broadside strikes all hostile creatures in a 4-meter-radius area. Each target makes an AGI saving throw against your class DC. On failure, it takes 4d8 + CHA modifier force damage and is pushed 3 meters away from the chosen point. On success, it takes half damage and is not pushed. Allies and friendly harbor forces are unaffected. Usable once per Action.",
          "flavor_text": "The silhouettes of warships emerge for a heartbeat and fire a synchronized volley."
        },
        {
          "id": "ss-lh-passive-01",
          "name": "Admiralty Presence",
          "scope": "personal",
          "rarity": "UNIQUE",
          "activation": "Passive",
          "group": "Passive",
          "full_rules": "While conscious, you and allied harbor forces within 10 meters of you gain +2 DEF against opportunity attacks. Once per round, when your general or one allied subordinate unit within 20 meters hits a hostile creature, you gain 4 temporary HP lasting until the beginning of your next turn. Temporary HP from this ability does not stack. Costs no MP or Action.",
          "flavor_text": "The sovereign grows harder to overwhelm as the harbor's forces press their advantage."
        },
        {
          "id": "ss-lh-reaction-01",
          "name": "Sovereign's Recall",
          "scope": "personal",
          "rarity": "UNIQUE",
          "activation": "Reaction",
          "group": "Reaction",
          "full_rules": "When you, your general, a subordinate unit, or a willing ally within 15 meters is targeted by a visible attack, spend 6 MP and your Reaction before the attack roll. Teleport the chosen target up to 5 meters to a visible unoccupied position. The attacker then resolves the attack if the new position remains a legal target; otherwise the attack misses. The protected target does not provoke opportunity attacks from this movement. Usable once per round.",
          "flavor_text": "A bell sounds beneath the water, and the threatened figure vanishes into mist."
        },
        {
          "id": "ss-lh-free-01",
          "name": "Raise the Signal",
          "scope": "personal",
          "rarity": "UNIQUE",
          "activation": "Free Action",
          "group": "Free Action",
          "full_rules": "Once per turn, spend 3 MP and choose either your general or one deployed subordinate unit within 30 meters. The chosen force immediately moves up to 4 meters without spending its own movement or Action, and its next successful attack before the end of its next turn deals an additional 1d8 force damage. The extra damage applies once. This movement does not trigger opportunity attacks. The ability may be used during your turn before or after your ordinary Action.",
          "flavor_text": "A burning pennant appears overhead, calling one formation into decisive motion."
        },
        {
          "id": "ss-lh-utility-01",
          "name": "Harbor Manifest",
          "scope": "personal",
          "rarity": "UNIQUE",
          "activation": "Utility, 1 minute",
          "group": "Utility",
          "full_rules": "Spend 2 MP and designate up to 20 willing creatures or objects within 10 meters, each object weighing no more than 200 kilograms. For 24 hours, you can identify which designated subjects remain within 1 kilometer of you, their approximate direction and distance, and whether a designated object has been opened or physically damaged since designation. You may maintain 20 designations at a time; new ones replace chosen older entries. You may review the manifest mentally at any time without an Action.",
          "flavor_text": "A luminous register of cargo and passengers unfolds behind the sovereign's eyes."
        },
        {
          "id": "ss-lh-utility-02",
          "name": "Temporary Mooring",
          "scope": "personal",
          "rarity": "UNIQUE",
          "activation": "Utility, 1 Action",
          "group": "Utility",
          "full_rules": "Spend 5 MP to create a fixed mooring point on a visible solid surface within 15 meters. The mooring remains for 1 hour, withstands up to 2,000 kilograms of steady pulling force, and holds one rope, cable, chain, or equivalent connection supplied by a creature within reach. It can secure a vessel, stabilize climbing equipment, anchor a bridge, or hold machinery. You may maintain three temporary moorings simultaneously. You may dismiss any of your moorings without an Action.",
          "flavor_text": "A black iron bollard rises from the surface and locks itself into place."
        },
        {
          "id": "ss-lh-sovereign-domain-01",
          "name": "Harbor Dominion",
          "scope": "sovereign",
          "sovereign_role": "domain",
          "rarity": "UNIQUE",
          "activation": "Domain Command, 1 minute; anchor relocation ritual, 1 hour",
          "group": "Sovereign Ability",
          "full_rules": "At Class selection, establish the Last Harbor pocket-domain with its stone quay, command hall, repair dock, storehouse, six berths, and an intact anchor-gate at a chosen accessible physical shoreline. The domain is immediately operational. The sovereign may enter or exit through its gate with authorized companions in 1 minute and may authorize or revoke entry for a creature while within 30 meters of the gate, taking 1 minute. Once per 7 days, the sovereign may spend 1 uninterrupted hour at a shoreline personally visited to relocate the anchor-gate there, closing its former physical entrance and opening the new one. Once per 24 hours, while physically inside the domain, the sovereign may use a 1-minute Domain Command to designate one of its existing structures as the expedition station. Until the next designation, authorized creatures preparing equipment there complete ordinary packing, loading, or unloading tasks in half their normal time, with a minimum of 1 minute. Designation costs no MP or Harbor Stores. Relocation costs 4 Harbor Stores. The domain and its structures remain physically present between activations.",
          "flavor_text": "The sovereign's decree moves the harbor's threshold and turns its docks toward the next expedition."
        },
        {
          "id": "ss-lh-sovereign-forces-01",
          "name": "Muster of the Twilight Fleet",
          "scope": "sovereign",
          "sovereign_role": "forces",
          "rarity": "UNIQUE",
          "activation": "Sovereign Order, 1 minute for deployment; 4 or 8 hours for restoration",
          "group": "Sovereign Ability",
          "full_rules": "At Class selection, muster one Breakwater Admiral and four Twilight Mariner units of three mariners each, with two units initially deployed and two in reserve. The sovereign may maintain one general and four total subordinate units at level 1, with no more than two subordinate units deployed beyond the domain at once. While within 30 meters of the anchor-gate, the sovereign may issue a 1-minute deployment order to exchange a deployed unit present at the gate for one reserve unit, with no MP or Harbor Stores cost. Units entering deployment emerge at the gate. Once per completed 24 hours, while the anchor-gate is intact and at least one unit is assigned to upkeep, the domain generates 2 Harbor Stores, up to a maximum of 12. At the domain repair dock, the sovereign may order restoration of a damaged surviving unit to full HP for 1 Harbor Store and 4 hours, or replacement of a destroyed unit for 2 Harbor Stores and 8 hours. Only one subordinate unit occupies the repair dock at a time. The defeated general reforms at full HP after 24 hours and expenditure of 6 Harbor Stores; a surviving general restores 20 HP after 8 hours resting in the command hall. The sovereign may issue these restoration orders from anywhere inside the domain in 1 minute. Repair and production timers advance through ordinary fictional time, and the general administers the work.",
          "flavor_text": "The harbor's bells call new crews to the quay while its dry dock restores the fallen."
        },
        {
          "id": "ss-lh-sovereign-command-01",
          "name": "Admiralty Directive",
          "scope": "sovereign",
          "sovereign_role": "command",
          "rarity": "UNIQUE",
          "activation": "Sovereign Command, 1 Free Action on the sovereign's turn; 1 minute outside combat",
          "group": "Sovereign Ability",
          "full_rules": "Once per round on your turn, spend 4 MP and your available Free Action to issue one combat directive to the Breakwater Admiral and up to two deployed Twilight Mariner units within 30 meters that can perceive your signal. Choose Assault, Hold, or Extract. Assault: each affected force gains +2 on its next attack roll against one hostile creature you designate within its normal attack reach during its next turn. Hold: each affected force gains +2 DEF until the start of your next turn, and the general may designate one adjacent ally to share this bonus. Extract: each affected force may immediately move up to 3 meters without opportunity attacks, and one willing adjacent ally chosen by the general may move with the general for the same distance. The directive does not grant an additional Action or attack to any force. Outside combat, the sovereign may issue one standing operational directive within 30 meters in 1 minute without MP cost, assigning the general and available units an achievable task such as patrol, transport, escort, reconnaissance, or fortification. The general determines the routine steps, provides a report when the task is finished or blocked, and retains independent tactical judgment. Combat use consumes the sovereign's normal Free Action for that turn.",
          "flavor_text": "One signal from the sovereign brings the admiral and crews into a single coordinated maneuver."
        }
      ],
      "utilities": [
        {
          "id": "ss-lh-utility-01",
          "name": "Harbor Manifest",
          "text": "Spend 1 minute and 2 MP marking up to 20 nearby willing creatures or objects. For 24 hours, identify their direction and distance within 1 kilometer and detect whether marked objects were opened or damaged. Useful for tracking expedition members, protecting cargo, organizing evacuations, detecting theft, and monitoring separated equipment."
        },
        {
          "id": "ss-lh-utility-02",
          "name": "Temporary Mooring",
          "text": "Use an Action and 5 MP to place a fixed anchor within 15 meters for 1 hour. Each anchor holds 2,000 kilograms of steady load, and three may exist together. Useful for climbing, vessel handling, securing temporary crossings, stabilizing heavy machinery, or preparing expedition camps."
        }
      ],
      "evolutions": [
        {
          "id": "ss-lh-evo-domain-01",
          "parent_id": "ss-lh-sovereign-domain-01",
          "name": "Forward Harbor",
          "text": "Harbor Dominion gains a temporary expedition entrance. While standing at a shoreline within 5 kilometers of the permanent anchor-gate, the sovereign may spend 2 Harbor Stores and 10 minutes to open a second, temporary gate for 8 hours. Authorized creatures and equipment may travel between either physical entrance and the domain. The temporary entrance closes when its duration ends, while the permanent anchor remains unchanged. This changes the domain from a single-entry headquarters into a two-point logistical route without permanently relocating the harbor."
        },
        {
          "id": "ss-lh-evo-forces-01",
          "parent_id": "ss-lh-sovereign-forces-01",
          "name": "Expedition Refit",
          "text": "Muster of the Twilight Fleet allows one deployed subordinate unit to be refitted at the repair dock as a Boarding, Survey, or Hauling formation during a 2-hour preparation period costing 1 Harbor Store. Boarding grants that unit a 3-meter climbing speed and allows its ordinary attack from a climbed position. Survey allows the unit to identify visible tracks, passages, and structural hazards within 15 meters with +3 on relevant checks. Hauling doubles its ordinary noncombat carrying capacity and allows it to move unsecured loads over ordinary obstacles without requiring separate handling checks. The refit lasts until changed and uses the unit's existing deployment slot, HP, DEF, attack, and Action economy."
        },
        {
          "id": "ss-lh-evo-command-01",
          "parent_id": "ss-lh-sovereign-command-01",
          "name": "Distributed Authority",
          "text": "Admiralty Directive can be transmitted through the Breakwater Admiral when the general is within 100 meters of the sovereign. The general may then relay the directive to eligible subordinate units within 30 meters of itself, even when those units are outside the sovereign's normal command reach. The sovereign selects the directive and pays its normal Free Action and MP cost. This changes command coverage and allows split-position operations while preserving the general's independent turn and the subordinate units' own Actions."
        }
      ],
      "evaluation": {
        "personal_starting_roles": {
          "active": 1,
          "passive": 1,
          "reaction": 1,
          "free_action": 1,
          "utilities": 2
        },
        "sovereign_starting_parent_roles": {
          "domain": 1,
          "forces": 1,
          "command": 1
        },
        "total_starting_root_abilities": 9,
        "sovereign_parent_evolutions": 3,
        "general_entity_abilities": 1,
        "subordinate_entity_abilities": 1,
        "creation_grant": "Automatic upon Class selection",
        "creation_stage_count": 4,
        "additional_creation_choices": 0,
        "player_agency": "The sovereign decides expedition objectives, tactical directives, domain relocation, expansion priorities, and consequential commitments. The general independently conducts ordinary tasks and responds to unfolding threats.",
        "combat_economy": "The sovereign receives one ordinary Action, one separately activated Free Action, movement, and one Reaction per standard combat round. Raise the Signal and Admiralty Directive compete for that same Free Action. The general and subordinate units retain their own turns.",
        "risk_and_quest_policy": "Forces have trackable HP, casualty costs, finite stores, deployment limits, and exposure to enemy action. Quests have precommitted objectives, opposition, meaningful resolutions, and attainable rewards. Domain management supports adventures rather than replacing them.",
        "design_status": "Unrolled read-only candidate; no campaign state changed."
      }
    }
  }
sovereign_format_defect: Missing root closing brace and ability fields nested under class_identity; normalized only for inspection, never saved or deployed as a kit

ability_updates.name: Survey the Fracture
ability_updates.full_rules: Outside combat, touch a solid structure or natural formation for 1 minute and spend 2 MP. Sense major breaks, hidden cavities, load-bearing routes, and unstable sections connected through the material within 15 meters. Learn their approximate positions and whether each examined route can safely support a human-sized creature. The information reflects the structure's present condition. Examine one connected structure per activation.
ability_updates.text: Strictly outside-combat structural survey for exploring ruins, locating cavities, assessing hazards, and identifying safe routes. Preserves the 1-minute activation, 2 MP cost, and 15-meter reach.

ability_updates.name: Lay the Crossing
ability_updates.full_rules: Outside combat, spend 1 minute and 6 MP to create up to four connected solid stepping platforms between visible points within 10 meters. Each platform is 1 meter wide, supports 200 kilograms, and lasts 10 minutes. Adjacent platforms may be separated by no more than 1 meter. The route may climb, descend, or turn around corners visible from the casting position. Dismiss the entire route without an Action. Maintain one crossing route at a time. The platforms immediately dissolve when combat begins.
ability_updates.text: Strictly outside-combat traversal utility for gaps, flooded floors, elevated access, and temporary evacuation routes. Preserves the 6 MP cost, platform capacity, reach, and duration. Activation becomes 1 minute, and the route dissolves when combat begins.

evolution_updates.name: Angle Breaker
evolution_updates.text: When Faultline Strike hits, you may use its movement to arrive on the opposite side of the target at a position within 3 meters that can support you. After arriving, push the target 2 meters into a vacant space.

evolution_updates.name: Shared Recoil
evolution_updates.text: Recoil Traverse can trigger when a visible ally within 3 meters is hit. Apply its damage reduction to that ally, who then performs the 2-meter movement.

evolution_updates.name: Hinged Crossing
evolution_updates.text: Outside combat, spend 1 minute to rotate an existing crossing route up to 90 degrees around one designated platform, repositioning its other platforms within 10 meters. Creatures standing on the platforms move with them. Usable once per crossing.

evolution_updates.name: Forward Harbor
evolution_updates.text: While standing at a shoreline within 5 kilometers of the permanent anchor-gate, spend 2 Harbor Stores and 10 minutes to open a second domain entrance for 8 hours. Authorized creatures and equipment may travel between either entrance and the domain.

evolution_updates.name: Expedition Refit
evolution_updates.text: At the repair dock, spend 2 hours and 1 Harbor Store to refit one deployed subordinate unit into a formation lasting until changed. Boarding grants a 3-meter climbing speed and permits attacks from climbed positions. Survey grants +3 on checks to identify visible tracks, passages, and structural hazards within 15 meters. Hauling doubles noncombat carrying capacity and permits moving unsecured loads over ordinary obstacles without separate handling checks.

evolution_updates.name: Distributed Authority
evolution_updates.text: When the Breakwater Admiral is within 100 meters of the sovereign, Admiralty Directive can be transmitted through the general to eligible subordinate units within 30 meters of the general. The sovereign selects the directive, and the general relays it.

remaining_findings: Utility repair changed the original activation time and added automatic dissolution on combat without being asked. Reject that drift.
These are partial-context candidate reviews; normal full-rules generation, actual tool behavior and long-play balance remain separate.
